$comment: Versioned baseline of what the MiniStack EMULATOR cannot check (tests/aws-integration/emulator/README.md, ADR 0602). Enforced by src/emulator-results.ts: an unlisted not-applicable item, a stale entry, an undeclared skip or fewer passes than minimumPasses fails ci.sh workflows. Ids are stable and never reused; review every change.

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack failure paths > RecordingFailed: when RecordFailure itself fails, the execution ends in the explicit Fail state and the job stays non-terminal
entries.reason: MiniStack DynamoDB does not reject SET a = a + :n on a non-numeric attribute (DynamoDB raises ValidationException), so RecordFailure cannot be made to fail this way
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26 DynamoDB: no ValidationException for SET a = a + :n on a non-numeric attribute.

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack execution timeout > TIMED_OUT leaves the job non-terminal; the reconciler skips it while RUNNING and closes it after
entries.reason: MiniStack never times out an execution: the state machine TimeoutSeconds is not enforced and TIMED_OUT is never set
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26 Step Functions: the state machine TimeoutSeconds is not enforced; no execution reaches TIMED_OUT.

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack conditional writes > a stale failure on a FAILED job is rejected by the RecordFailure condition; the first error is kept
entries.reason: MiniStack ignores Fail-state ErrorPath/CausePath: a failed execution reports error States.Fail and no cause
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26 Step Functions: a Fail state reports only its static Error (States.Fail); ErrorPath/CausePath are not evaluated. Unchanged in 1.5.27.

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack IAM and KMS > IAM: the deployed roles are allowed what they need and denied what they must not (SimulatePrincipalPolicy)
entries.reason: MiniStack stores IAM policies without enforcing them; its SimulatePrincipalPolicy is its own evaluator, not AWS
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26 with AUTH unset (the CI service): no IAM policy evaluation; the opt-in AUTH=true evaluates identity policies only (no boundaries, resource or session policies).

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack IAM and KMS > KMS: a principal with DynamoDB read but no CMK grant cannot read the encrypted table or use the key
entries.reason: MiniStack enforces neither KMS key policies nor the caller-side KMS checks of DynamoDB and Step Functions
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26 and 1.5.27: no KMS key-policy or grant evaluation, no caller-side KMS checks in DynamoDB/Step Functions (key policies only on the unreleased main branch).

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack IAM and KMS > KMS: tables, execution history and every log group use the stack CMK (rotation on)
entries.reason: MiniStack enforces neither KMS key policies nor the caller-side KMS checks of DynamoDB and Step Functions
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26 and 1.5.27: no KMS key-policy or grant evaluation, no caller-side KMS checks in DynamoDB/Step Functions (key policies only on the unreleased main branch).

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack failure paths > Lambda service errors: a throttled processor is retried 1 + maxAttempts times, then caught into RecordFailure
entries.reason: Reserved concurrency 0 does not throttle Step Functions task invocations in MiniStack (the execution succeeds)
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26: reserved concurrency 0 does not throttle Step Functions task invocations.

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack conditional writes > a stale failure on a FAILED job is rejected by the RecordFailure condition; the first error is kept
entries.reason: MiniStack's socket-less local Lambda executor reports every handler error as Runtime.HandlerError (the thrown error's name is dropped), so Retry/Catch on handler error names (TransientDependencyError, DuplicateExecutionError) and error-name assertions cannot be verified
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26 LAMBDA_EXECUTOR=local (socket-less; the CI service): the warm-worker path reports every handler error as errorType Runtime.HandlerError (thrown name dropped). Unchanged in 1.5.27 (latest release as of 2026-10-15). Closed by an upstream fix that keeps err.name, or by the docker executor on a dedicated, disposable runner.

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack log canary scan > state machine group: a marker placed in an execution input is found (execution data logged), no canary marker
entries.reason: MiniStack stores the state machine logging configuration but delivers no execution events to CloudWatch Logs
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26 Step Functions: the logging configuration is stored, no execution event is delivered to CloudWatch Logs.

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack workflow > the ASL forwards only the spec fields: no task input in the history carries the extra field
entries.reason: MiniStack records no task input in the execution history (TaskScheduled carries the resource only)
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26 execution history: TaskScheduled/LambdaFunctionScheduled events carry no task input.

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack versions and alias rollback > runs through the alias, routes it to a failing version, and rolls back by repointing it
entries.reason: MiniStack runs executions started through a version or alias on the latest revision, omits their version/alias ARNs, and its CloudFormation does not provision StateMachineVersion/Alias
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26 CloudFormation: no AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion/StateMachineAlias types; executions through an alias run the latest revision.

entries.test: [ministack-emulator] integration stack failure paths > retry: a transient processor failure is retried with backoff and the job SUCCEEDS
entries.reason: MiniStack implements neither MaxDelaySeconds nor JitterStrategy of a Retrier (plain exponential backoff), so the capped, jittered waits between retries are not verifiable
entries.dependsOn: MiniStack 1.5.26 Step Functions: Retrier MaxDelaySeconds and JitterStrategy are not implemented (plain exponential backoff, capped at 60 s).
